scope: Audio conversion, provider transports, transcription lifecycle, and local Whisper inference

fixed.issue: Stopping a native session did not call the provider stop method, leaving requests and workers running.
fixed.change: The session runner forwards cancellation after up to 3 seconds of graceful drain, awaits provider cleanup, releases capture, and forwards startup errors. Responsive providers preserve captured final words. Unresponsive requests are cancelled after the grace. Already-cancelled sessions do not start a provider, and stopped per-session provider instances remain stopped.

fixed.issue: OpenAI, Groq, and Deepgram hybrid polling blocked the async runtime while waiting for audio.
fixed.change: Audio waits now yield to transcript, transport, and stop tasks.

fixed.issue: OpenAI and Groq silently discarded failed requests for the last buffered audio chunk.
fixed.change: Both full and final chunks return and publish request failures. Requests have a time limit and cancellation interrupts in-flight requests.

fixed.issue: Deepgram socket tasks could outlive disconnected sessions, and final transcripts could be lost during stream close.
fixed.change: Socket reads, writes, and audio bridging share one lifecycle. Unexpected closes reconnect. Normal input close waits for the final server transcript.

fixed.issue: Deepgram explicit error messages were ignored and hybrid REST failures were only logged.
fixed.change: Explicit provider errors reach the operator. Hybrid fallback reports failures and flushes remaining audio when its input closes.

fixed.issue: A corrupt Whisper model left its audio worker waiting and reported connected before loading completed.
fixed.change: Model failures stop the audio worker and return an error. Connected is emitted only after the model and inference state are ready. Stop can abort active inference.

fixed.issue: Whisper required six voiced frames but retained four pre-speech frames, cutting off the start of speech.
fixed.change: Whisper retains six pre-speech frames. The generated spoken fixture now retains its first word.

fixed.issue: After transcription stopped, the microphone meters retained their last live level.
fixed.change: Both explicit Stop and native session completion reset RMS and peak to zero. A failed Stop preserves the still-active meter state.

local_end_to_end: Generated stereo PCM is downmixed to the active channel, resampled from 48 kHz to 16 kHz, and gain limited.
Real loopback HTTP multipart WAV request preserves PCM bytes and returns a final transcript.
Final HTTP 401 errors reach the event stream and return an error.
Real loopback Deepgram WebSocket session reconnects after server close and resumes transcript delivery.
WebSocket stream closure preserves its last final transcript and all buffered PCM bytes.
Idle sockets and audio readers stop without requiring audio input to be closed.
Explicit Deepgram error messages terminate the socket session and reach the event stream.
Real loopback Deepgram REST requests preserve raw PCM bytes and word timestamps, and reject HTTP 429 and malformed JSON.
Native session cancellation closes an in-flight HTTP transcription request promptly.
Missing and corrupt Whisper models fail without a false connected event or a retained audio worker.
Generated speech passes through the native voice detector and real Whisper tiny.en inference.
Active real Whisper inference cancels cleanly without an error event.
Pre-cancelled sessions and stopped providers do not activate the connection or process queued audio.
Explicit Stop preserves the last partial audio batch and its final transcript when the local server responds promptly; a held request is force cancelled after the 3-second grace.
A mounted transcription hook handles native stt_stopped by clearing its audio meter and recording state.

real_whisper.fixture: Generated with macOS Samantha speech, converted to mono 16 kHz PCM16. No microphone recording used.
real_whisper.spoken_text: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son. John chapter three, verse sixteen.
real_whisper.transcript_before_onset_fix: God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten son. John chapter 3, verse 16.
real_whisper.transcript_after_onset_fix: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten son, John chapter 3, verse 16.
real_whisper.model_scope: Public tiny.en test model. The standard app model was not replaced.

limits: This agent did not operate the native UI or access the microphone. The parent agent owns those app checks.
No real cloud API keys or vault credentials were accessed by this agent, and no paid calls were made.
Cloud provider request and failure tests used local HTTP and WebSocket servers with test keys.
The normal large-v3-turbo model was not present locally. Real offline inference used the public tiny.en test model.
Deepgram REST transport was exercised separately; automatic fallback from the official cloud endpoint was not forced.

reproduction.before_fix: The final-buffer HTTP 401 regression failed because the provider returned Ok without reporting its failed final request.
reproduction.after_fix: The regression and transport/lifecycle checks pass.

independent_review: The broadcast/remote agent reviewed socket/audio worker cleanup, the pre-cancelled start race, and the 3-second graceful Stop branch. No further concrete lifecycle issue remained after the fixes.
coordinated_change: The direct transcription detection path now filters unresolved invalid verses with detection::to_result, waits for AppState resolution instead of emitting unvalidated lock-contention fallbacks, and derives high confidence from resolved results. Parser and DB validation tests belong to the documents/media agent.

native_release_history.observation: Generated speech played through speakers produced no visible transcript during this run. Capture and a microphone meter were active. A brief provider-channel backpressure burst reached 300 dropped frames; no further 100-frame drop report appeared before Stop.
native_release_history.stop: Capture stopped at 11:31:49 UTC; websocket, provider, and event consumer exited at 11:31:50 UTC.
native_release_history.cause: Not established. A sample completed after Stop could not identify an earlier wait. The final fresh optimized run below produced transcripts successfully; that success does not establish the cause of this earlier empty run.
